gap: Protection holds only as far as Zite's own session verification does; no Semester-side evidence or test of Zite's claims (issuer/audience/alg). Owner should obtain vendor assurance. The JWT middleware in docs/execution/rls/api is a reference for a future separate API, not deployed.
